PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits both parts of Angus's clue ("He was in the Woods, but not beside a shrub."). So Angus (A) must be at row 4, column 8. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Suppose Daisy were at row 5, column 2: then nobody could stand in column 6. So Daisy can't be there. Suppose Daisy were at row 6, column 2: then Frederick's clue ("He was with Daisy.") could not be true. So Daisy can't be there. Suppose Virgil were at row 6, column 6: then Brenda would have nowhere left to go. So Virgil can't be there. The same kind of reasoning rules out a few more squares. Emil is now the only person who can still go in row 3. So Emil (E) must be at row 3, column 1. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Daisy and Frederick can only use rows 5 and 6 between them, so nobody else can be in those rows. So Carmen (C) must be at row 1, column 2. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Gordon is now the only person who can still go in column 7. So Gordon (G) must be at row 2, column 7. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Daisy's own clue ("She was exactly one column west of Gordon. She was not sitting in a chair.") rules out more squares. So Daisy (D) must be at row 5, column 6. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: Look at Brenda: every square she could still use shares a row or column with row 7, column 4. So nobody else can stand at row 7, column 4, or Brenda would have nowhere to go. Brenda's clue ("Someone else in her area was beside a stump.") needs the person beside a stump in Brenda's area on a square that does not share her row or column; that rules out squares for Brenda. Using Frederick's clue ("He was east of Brenda."), some squares are ruled out for Brenda. So Brenda (B) must be at row 8, column 4. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Frederick that fits his clue ("He was with Daisy. He was east of Brenda."). So Frederick (F) must be at row 6, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Virgil. So Virgil (the victim) must be at row 7, column 3. Cross out his row and column. Brenda is the only person in the Trail with Virgil, so Brenda is the murderer!
